searchText: the thing you've all been waiting for! a (qt-based) GUI for making web3 JSON-RPC requests to your node: https://github.com/arnetheduck/nora-poc - in reality, it's a dummy project for prototyping some particular nim macros, but hey, it works and even runs on android should you need to check something on the go 🙂 <@412614104222531604> this is possibly another niche case, for prysm we have a flag for adding beacon node fall back urls for rest endpoints, it looks something like --beacon-rest-api-provider=http://primary-beacon:5052,http://fallback-beacon:5052, is this something i can inject in kurtosis? it's a lot of manual wiring to make sure the validator client is deployed via docker compose + added to the right network to manually attempt to do this flag not sure if you have suggestions would need to modify the ethereum package for this but could probably be done in a few mins happy to make you a pr if it’s a one off test on monday if you want something more permanent I’ll have to take a deeper look
